dispute.claim_text: I arrived at the pin and waited nine minutes. The passenger was late. The rules say I get compensated for waiting beyond the minimum. I don't have to call anyone.

counterparty_statement.text: He never called, never messaged. I only saw on the app that he'd 'arrived' when I thought to check. I dragged my luggage to him. When I asked why he didn't come to the door he said 'not my job'. Now he wants money for waiting?
